headline: Bombardier Raises Cash Forecast After Delivering 33 Jets in Latest Quarter
summary: Bombardier hiked its cash forecast as quarterly revenue edged up 3% year-over-year to $2.37 billion following the delivery of 33 business jets.
why: Aerospace manufacturers' delivery volumes and cash flow projections serve as health metrics for private aviation demand and operational execution.

impacts.name: Bombardier
impacts.why: Higher revenue and upgraded cash forecasts signal improved financial health and liquidity.
